configuration.binary_targets: Existing meaningful 0/1 indicators retained; OLS is an unclipped linear-probability diagnostic, not calibrated classification. Top10 outcomes exclude already Top10 debuts, as in V1.

categories.1: A: direct reconstruction or target dependency
categories.3: C: different families with conceptual overlap
categories.4: D: distinct domains with shared recorded provenance
categories.5: E: distinct domains and disjoint recorded measurement provenance

configuration.commercial_windows: Existing 12/26-week columns only; all populations use complete 26-week windows to equalize maximum fixed-window predictor availability
configuration.counts: One categorical/multilabel variable; season sine/cosine jointly one construct, not two targets
configuration.cross_domain: D/E only: all predictors in different substantive families and no prespecified conceptual-overlap proxy. The broader C/D/E different-family audit is also retained.
configuration.estimator: Additive OLS with intercept, all unordered 1/2/3-variable combinations, no screening, no interactions/regularization/clipping
configuration.final_refit: All eligible labels available before 2018; retrospective modern content/metadata remain explicitly retrospective
configuration.genre_provenance: Frozen genre prompt uses Billboard identity and first chart date, MB/Wikidata tags and learned genre knowledge; explicitly forbids lyrics/content scores/chart performance. Genre is not provenance-separated from Billboard or MB.
configuration.leaderboard: Top relationships ranked by validation R2 only; preserve global top combinations and one-winner-per-target views separately. No evaluation performance used to select figures or winners.
configuration.lifetime: Existing V2 prefix-at-cutoff definition; age >=5 calendar years and inactivity >=2 years. Other rows have missing lifetime predictors; lifetime targets require observed eligible labels. Not verified completed careers.
configuration.new_features: None created; reuse all 57 existing constructs, V2 debut/date encodings, and the original campaign release-year/last-date encodings
configuration.objective: Cross-domain variable prediction; not a commercial-forecast-only campaign
configuration.population: Existing V2 retrospective cohort: complete 42 scores and nonempty existing lyric structure; post-1960 debut; complete 26-week window; observed target only. Same target cohort across every configuration/view/candidate.
configuration.population_reason: Prevents absent content acquisition/final monthly-selection status from becoming a predictor of chart success; still a selected enriched cohort, not all entrants.
configuration.preprocessing: Training medians, numeric/dummy standardization, observed training categorical/multilabel vocabulary; constant encoded columns removed but conceptual candidates retained; no missingness flags; unseen categories raw all zero
configuration.provenance: E requires disjoint recorded measurement-source sets and no overlap/dependency rule. Common identity joins and selection are not proof of statistical independence. Unknown pretrained knowledge remains a limitation.
configuration.registry: All original raw MB duration summaries retained with distinct populations and uncertainty; their relationships to each other/consistent duration are A, not independent measurements. Catalog counts measure retained linked catalog coverage, not artist merit.
configuration.relationship_precedence: Worst pair category determines combination; any compound reconstruction overrides to A. Mixed same-family/cross-domain models remain B.
configuration.selection: Equal-period mean validation R2; then fewer original variables; then lexicographic tuple. Baseline MSE skill is reported separately. All selections locked before any evaluation.
configuration.storage: Float64 dense disk arrays for all period MAE/MSE; uint16 rank/fallback, global candidate catalog, full relationship audit, validation order. Metrics derived losslessly from fold constants. No duplicate giant CSV or millions of fitted models.
configuration.support: At least 100 training and 30 validation identities and nonconstant target in all three validation folds; no evaluation-score screening
configuration.target_missingness: Never impute targets. All predictor combinations share the target-specific observed-label cohort.
configuration.uncertainty: Paired fixed-prediction bootstrap by exact artist credit and debut year; excludes refitting/search uncertainty. Artist aliases and collaboration overlap remain.
